_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: 30% positive before; after, 80% if positive and 20% if negative before

agreement.claim: both engines report the same change, interval, discordant counts, McNemar chi-square and exact p-value
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 at ten significant digits on every key. harness/categorical_examples.test.py checks the chi-square against (b - c)^2 / (b + c) and the exact p against the binomial, and shows the continuity-corrected and unpaired statistics are different numbers.

recovery.claim: the change in proportion positive is close to the one the fixture was built with

calibration.limits: Measured by harness/categorical_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99. At 200 pairs the miss (0.065) was close to the true change of 0.08, so the fixture uses 500.
